VALUE:
Tap a place. Its card slides up from the bottom. Tap or drag the triangle up for more, or down to close it.

Filter by category. Tap a category at the top to hide or show it; tap All to bring them all back.

Day or night. The moon and sun button switches between Day and Night Modes. The map remembers your choice.

Change the map. The layers button switches between the standard map, a topographic map and aerial photos.

Share a place. Open a place and tap Share. The link takes your friend straight to it.
